data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #5): the sweep-simulation mechanism MUST be deterministic + idempotent. Recipe: on the mktemp copy, rewrite/remove every legacy_call( line that does NOT contain '# OMITTED-SITE'; preserve the omitted line so it is the ONLY surviving call-expression match post-sweep. Requirements: (a) omitted site is the only surviving match; (b) rewrite is idempotent (double-run determinism depends on it); (c) does not touch import lines or test files. Verify: the test's sweep step is deterministic (--case determinism passes) and post-sweep exactly 1 legacy_call match remains.
